title: 2.8.2.2 Dev : can't restart loop if stopped
symptom: In 2.8.2.2 dev, if the loop is stopped from the main page, it cannot be restarted from the main UI; the user must go to settings/config generator to reactivate the loop. Also, when activated, a strange '364days (deactivated ?)' appears under the button.
cause: The issue is partially caused by a bug in disabling the loop, and there is a constraint that prevents direct switching from open loop to closed loop. The exact cause for the inability to restart after stopping is not fully identified in the thread.
fix: The issue was reported as 'should be resolved now' by MilosKozak, and a user confirmed that disconnecting/reconnecting pump works and extending disconnection time is possible. However, the original reporter later stated it is only partially solved: open loop to closed loop works, but stopping and restarting from main UI still requires going to config generator. No specific fix or workaround is provided for the remaining issue.
